turns.replyText:
My tracking says delivered but I didn't receive it, what now?
If your tracking indicates delivered but you have not received the package, please follow these steps:
Double-check the delivery location: Inspect entrances, porches, side doors, garages, parcel lockers, mailrooms, or with reception/security if applicable.
Ask neighbors or others in the household: Carriers may leave packages with a nearby neighbor or another person at the address.
Allow additional time: In some cases, carriers mark a package as delivered shortly before it is actually dropped off.
Review delivery details using your tracking link: The tracking link is typically sent once the order ships. If you are signed in, the system may also display your latest order status and tracking information in the next message.
For delivery timing after shipment, the following general estimates are provided on our shipping page:
- Eastern USA: approximately 2 to 6 days (Florida: 5 to 8 days)
- Central and Western USA: approximately 3 to 6 days
- Delays may occur during U.S. customs clearance.
If you wish, in your next message I can assist with either of the following:
- Check whether the system can display your latest order status/tracking if you are signed in, or
- Help determine the next step based on the information shown on the tracking page.
